changeSummary: Steps 1-20 (age-range through user-info-email) are structurally unchanged from the previous schema (same order, same singleChoice/multiChoice/info/textInput/textInputPair types, same popupOnExit on user-info-name). Two real changes found at the tail of the funnel: (1) lesson-time-select (scheduling step) no longer requires explicit day/time-of-day/slot selection before the book button enables - in this run a day (tomorrow), time-of-day (morning) and exact slot (10:30) were pre-selected by default and 'Забронювати урок' was already clickable; also the popupOnExit confirmation dialog ('Лишилося зробити всього один крок...') seen in the previous run did NOT appear this run - clicking the book button navigated straight to a new step. (2) A brand-new step 'telegram-bot' now follows lesson-time-select, replacing the old terminal 'request-gotten' page entirely - it shows a 'Пробний урок заброньовано' confirmation plus a Telegram-bot subscribe CTA and a 'Далі' button. That 'Далі' button no longer leads to a quiz-scoped terminal screen; it navigates out of the funnel into the authenticated app area (observed landing on the generic /uk/app/login screen in this run, an artifact of the mocked/fake oauth session not being a real authenticated session against the live backend - a genuinely logged-in user would presumably land in their real dashboard instead). No true in-funnel terminal/confirmation step (type=terminal) was reachable this run; telegram-bot is now the practical end of the discoverable quiz. Booking-endpoint hypothesis narrowed: POST https://stage.allright.com/api/v1/lessons is confirmed as the real trial-lesson booking call (mocked and validated); the other four hypothesized patterns (tmp-lessons, trial-lessons, bookings, permanent-schedule) were armed but not hit and can likely be dropped from the hypothesis list, though kept for this run's safety net. Also newly discovered: submitting user-info-phone (which mints the fake oauth session) triggers a client-side redirect chain through several /uk/not-found hits and lands on the marketing homepage (/uk) if the follow-up GET /api/v1/users?...&me=true is left unmocked and returns a real 401 - this run added a supplementary read-only mock for that endpoint (not in the original mutating-endpoint list) to keep the flow traversable; this is a non-mutating GET so it does not violate the no-real-writes guardrail, but is a new operational dependency worth carrying into future runs of this agent.
observedExperiments: GET /api/v1/users?...&me=true accepts an include=...,UserExperiments relation, implying a server-side per-user experiment/variant framework exists, though no specific experiment/variant name or client-side cookie/flag was directly observed this run

Behavioral variant at lesson-time-select: default pre-selected day/time-of-day/slot (this run) vs. requiring explicit selection before the book button enables (previous run) - likely an A/B variant of the scheduling widget

New telegram-bot step post-booking, replacing the previous run's confirmation popup + separate request-gotten terminal page - likely a funnel-variant change rather than a permanent-fixture, since the whole tail of the funnel differs from the prior mapping
